nodes.name: Opening cut
nodes.description: A direct sword cut that remains the low-commitment foundation of the branch.

deepening.explanation: Establishes the branch with the existing direct melee sword action.

nodes.name: Committed opening cut
nodes.description: Spends stamina to preserve the opening cut while making resource readiness matter.

deepening.explanation: Adds a stamina admission condition instead of replacing the free foundation.

nodes.name: Opening return cut
nodes.description: Links the first cut to a separately timed and separately paid return strike.

deepening.explanation: Deepens the branch through a two-stage combination and a second-stage cost.

nodes.name: Advancing opening cut
nodes.description: Combines the opening attack with committed forward movement and knockback.

deepening.explanation: Adds a tactical approach mode with displacement and a cooldown.

nodes.name: Opening circle
nodes.description: Trades a long active sweep, stamina and cooldown for radial space control.

deepening.explanation: Specializes the initiative branch for nearby space rather than a single thrust line.
deepening.conditionOrTradeoff: Requires stamina and commits to a 20-step radial sweep and cooldown.

nodes.name: Decisive opening circle
nodes.description: Uses the reviewed trained radial action as a high-output but committed opener.

deepening.explanation: Caps the slice with the existing attack-scaled sweep without removing its commitment.
deepening.conditionOrTradeoff: Retains the stamina cost, 20-step sweep, recovery opening and cooldown.
